items.informal_description: For a commutative ring $ A $, an $ A $-module $ M $, and a finite type $ \iota $ with decidable equality, this function constructs a ring homomorphism from the endomorphism ring $ \mathrm{End}_A(M) $ to $ A $ using a truncated basis of $ M $. The truncation ensures basis independence, making the determinant well-defined as a ring element.

items.informal_name: Determinant of Scalar Restriction Equals Algebra Norm
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  [Module.Free R S] [inst_4 : AddCommGroup A] [inst_5 : Module R A] [inst_6 : Module S A] [inst_7 : IsScalarTower R S A]
  [Module.Free S A] {f : A →ₗ[S] A}, LinearMap.det (↑R f) = (Algebra.norm R) (LinearMap.det f)
items.informal_description: For a free $ S $-module $ A $ equipped with a scalar tower $ R 	o S 	o A $, the determinant of the restriction of an $ S $-linear endomorphism $ f : A 	o A $ to an $ R $-linear map equals the algebra norm $ \mathcal{N}_{S/R} $ applied to the determinant of $ f $. Formally, $ \det(f_{|R}) = \mathcal{N}_{S/R}(\det_S(f)) $, where $ f_{|R} $ denotes the scalar-restricted map and $ \mathcal{N}_{S/R} $ is the norm map from $ S $ to $ R $.

items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommGroup M] {A : Type u_5} [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Module A M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] {P : A → Prop} (f : M →ₗ[A] M),
  (∀ (s : Finset M) (b : Module.Basis (↥s) A M), P ((LinearMap.toMatrix b b) f).det) → P 1 → P (LinearMap.det f)
items.informal_description: Let $ A $ be a commutative ring and $ M $ a finite-dimensional free $ A $-module. For any linear endomorphism $ f : M \to M $ and property $ P : A \to \mathrm{Prop} $, if $ P $ holds for the determinant of the matrix representation of $ f $ with respect to every basis of $ M $, and $ P(1) $ holds, then $ P $ holds for the determinant of $ f $.

items.informal_name: Determinant Ring Homomorphism for Endomorphisms of an A-Module
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommGroup M] {A : Type u_5} [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Module A M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M],
  ⇑LinearMap.det = ⇑(if H : ∃ s, Nonempty (Module.Basis (↥s) A M) then LinearMap.detAux (Trunc.mk ⋯.some) else 1)
items.informal_description: For a commutative ring $ A $ and an $ A $-module $ M $ (which is an additive commutative group), the determinant is a ring homomorphism from the endomorphism ring $ \mathrm{End}_A(M) $ to $ A $, assigning to each linear endomorphism $ f : M \to M $ its determinant $ \det(f) \in A $. This homomorphism satisfies $ \det(\mathrm{id}_M) = 1 $ and $ \det(f \circ g) = \det(f) \cdot \det(g) $.

items.informal_description: For a commutative ring $ A $ and a free $ A $-module $ M $, the determinant of the zero linear map $ 0 : M \to M $ is equal to $ 0 $ raised to the power of the finite rank of $ M $ over $ A $, i.e., $ \det(0) = 0^{\text{rank}_A(M)} $.
